svg.title: Kapouleas--Kleene--Møller shrinkers: gluing and end schematics
svg.desc: The left panel shows the exact sphere-plane input configuration, not a desingularized surface. The right panel is a generic nonplanar cone schematic, not the computed cone of a KKM shrinker. The theorem gives one end for every sufficiently large prescribed genus.

g.text: Existence for every sufficiently large integer genus
S²(2) ∪ P; circle to be resolved
Exactly one end for all constructed large-genus surfaces.
Neither panel is a solved shrinker or its computed cone.
SCHEMATIC • gluing input and asymptotic geometry
